plainText:
The Matori Matrix (Japanese: マトリマトリックス Matori Matrix) is a group of recurring characters who appeared in . They are a special Team Rocket elite unit under the leadership of Matori, 's personal secretary.

==History==
=== ===
The Matori Matrix debuted in Filling the Light with Darkness!, where they approached Alola by helicopter. They were contacted by Giovanni, who asked for a briefing on the progress of their mission. Their target was to catch the " ".

In Full Moon and Many Arms!, they were approaching Alola, only to suddenly be left lethargic due to draining Ultra Aura from the adults around the region. Despite this, they succeeded in catching Necrozma, who had fused with to take on its . However, Necrozma quickly broke free of the net. They later launched another attack on Lunala and Nebby, but were forced to retreat after being hit by . They reappeared, no longer feeling lethargic when Necrozma fused with Nebby and fled through an Ultra Wormhole.

In The Prism Between Light and Darkness!, they witnessed the Ultra Guardians following Lunala through an Ultra Wormhole. They attempted to follow, only to be stopped by , , and their . Having sustained too much damage, it was unsafe for them to proceed through the Ultra Wormhole. Gozu and several Team Rocket Grunts subsequently headed down to Ten Carat Hill whilst Matori remained on the aircraft to conduct repairs. Gozu easily defeated , , and with his , only to be defeated by in Securing the Future!. Gozu's group returned to the aircraft when Matori announced the completion of the repairs. They prepared to flying through the Ultra Wormhole, only to be attacked by , forcing them to retreat.

They reappeared in Spying for the Big Guy!, when Matori arrived in Alola to collect for Giovanni. Realizing that getting Bewear was near impossible, Matori decided to return with instead, only to be tricked by Jessie, James, and who disguised Meowth as Stufful. Bewear came to Meowth's rescue, causing the helicopter to crash.

=== ===
In A Little Rocket R & R!, Matori led a group of Grunts to steal Pokémon in the Resort Area. They initially succeeded, but with Jessie and James's help, and Goh managed to get the stolen Pokémon back and force Matori and her Grunts to retreat.

They reappeared in Nightfall? Nightmares! and A Midsummer Night's Light!, attempting to capture the lunar duo. After escaped, Matori contacted Jessie, James, and Meowth to assist with Matori planning to blame any failure on their part. After finding Cresselia and , Matori led an attack, only for Ash, , Goh, and Chloe stopping them before being put to sleep by Darkrai's .

 counterparts of the Matori Matrix members appeared as part of Alternate World Team Rocket in Showdown at the Gates of Warp!. Unlike their counterparts from the main world, they were under the command of Alternate World Jessie, James, and Meowth instead of Matori.

==Trivia==
Matori Matrix is the first recurring Team Rocket unit in the to feature more than three recurring members.
It is also the first unit to not be associated with a Team Rocket scientist.
The , , and prominently used by the Matori Matrix Grunts mimic the signature Pokémon of Team Galactic s Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn.
